messages:
Emma: Heads-up — ClientX edge SI onboarding touching AWS Marketplace + on‑prem drivers. They hit an arch blocker: HW partner requires signed firmware + a strict IP allowlist before marketplace listing. Need eng + security signoff ASAP.
Jordan: When's the review? I can join the call.
Emma: Preflight booked Wed 11am PT, calendar invite sent. We need: network diagram, AMI build flow, KMS key policy, and firmware signing checklist.
Priya: Draft network/arch diagram uploaded: https://drive.google.com/d/1ExampleLink (permissions: partnerships view). @Rafael can you confirm driver compatibility notes?
Rafael: Ran driver tests — failure on 2/3 edge boards (kernel panic on boot under 6.1). HW partner says it's a known issue and will provide a patch, but timing unclear. Also SR‑IOV tables look off; need logs. This blocks our Marketplace AMI build.
Mike: Looping in eng-platform/eng-infra. @onboard-bot opening ticket and attaching build logs.
onboard-bot: Ticket RB-7890 created: "clientx-edge-driver-firmware". Assignee: Rafael. Priority: P0. Due: 2026-03-24. Link: https://issues.internal/RB-7890
Rafael: Temporary workaround proposal: pin kernel to 5.15 for the AMI build to unblock Marketplace packaging. I'll add the change to the build script and mark it as temporay.
Jordan: Kernel pinning is ok as a short stopgap but we shouldn't ship that long-term. Eng-infra, can we get a backport/patch scheduled? /cc @Priya for AMI tests.
Priya: I'll list required config changes and start the legal checklist for firmware signing (what signatures + audit logs we need). Also adding KMS rotation notes.
Emma: Action items: 1) Rafael - validate patched driver & attach test matrix to RB-7890; 2) Mike - get HW partner signing contact + NDA; 3) Priya - finalize network/KMS doc; 4) Jordan - prepare canary & rollback plan for Marketplace AMI. If HW contact not provided by EOD Thu we escalate to Partnerships lead.
Mike: HW contact: sara@hwpartner.com — pinged for patch + signed NDA scan.
Rafael: If partner can't deliver patch in time, fallback is Dedicated-only deployment using our internal driver shim. Need decision by Friday to avoid blocking customer launch.
Jordan: Noted. We'll cover canary checklist in Wed preflight and pick fallback path. I'll add the canary checklist to the meeting doc.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Emma: Also tagging eng-security to review firmware signing flow before we finalize Marketplace submission. @eng-security please chime in on required audit fields and key custody.
Mike: I'll update RB-7890 with vendor responses and add links to the build pipeline logs.
Rafael: Uploading kernel oops + syslogs to the ticket now.
Emma: Thanks all — see you on the preflight. If anything urgent come up, ping here and I'll escalate.
